fields.description: Issue includes coverage of a reported assault on the paper's publisher and related legal proceedings; editorials on Miami municipal finance opposing a general sales tax and proposing alternative revenue measures; discussion of the closing of horse-betting "books" and its economic effects; a campaign feature urging traffic-safety cooperation with the Miami Police Department ahead of the school term; local political and civic commentary (including the telephone rate case); and community/society items and promotions, including the "Most Attractive Working Girl" contest (winner: Miss Elsie Shope of the Mark Store) and advertisements.
